product_metadata.title: Bamboo Lids for Ball/Kerr Mason Jars, 86mm Wide Mouth Mason Jar Lids with Straw Hole, Eco and Reusable (8 PCS)
features: 【About Size】Our bamboo jar lid measures approx. 86 x 70 mm in outer diameter and inner diameter, they can work with most of wide mouth mason jars. Diameter of straw hole measures approx. 15 mm/ 0.59 inch, fits most of straw.
【Natural Bamboo Material】Mason jar lids with straw hole are made by 100% naturally bamboo material, which is biodegradable and safe to use, not easy to deform or break.

【PRACTICAL ACCESSORIES 】- Each Bamboo Mason Jar lid is attached with an o-ring silicone gasket, A sealing gasket is embedded in the middle of the wide mouth mason jar lids. which not only prevents the mason jar straw lids from slipping off, but also prevents drinks from spilling on the table to protect your table. It’s removable, suitable for with most regular mouth mason jar and canning jar.
【Warm tips】: 1. clean lids after using; 2. do not use water above 85°; 3. do not store any liquid in the mason jar when not in use; 4. not suitable for preserving or water immersion.
